import bpy
from pathlib import Path
src=Path('${base}/flatiron.py').read_text()
src=src[src.index('import bpy, math'):]
a=src.index('p=argparse.ArgumentParser()');b=src.index("bpy.ops.object.select_all")
src=src[:a]+"REV=1\nOUT='${base}'\n"+src[b:]
bpy._flatiron_ns={'__name__':'flatiron_live'}
bpy._flatiron_src=src
exec(src[:src.index('for idx,(q,t,n,bw)')],bpy._flatiron_ns)
print('Live geometry initialized; bays',len(bpy._flatiron_ns['bays']),'floor intervals',len(bpy._flatiron_ns['levels'])-1,'Blender',bpy.app.version_string)

import bpy
src=bpy._flatiron_src
exec(src[src.index('for idx,(q,t,n,bw)'):src.index('# Lighting and camera')],bpy._flatiron_ns)
from mathutils import Vector
s=bpy.context.scene
s.unit_settings.system='METRIC'
bpy.ops.object.camera_add(location=(110,155,83))
c=bpy.context.object;c.name='Presentation camera';c.rotation_euler=(Vector((0,-1,43))-c.location).to_track_quat('-Z','Y').to_euler();c.data.type='ORTHO';c.data.ortho_scale=111;s.camera=c
for a in bpy.context.screen.areas:
 if a.type=='VIEW_3D':
  a.spaces.active.region_3d.view_perspective='CAMERA'
  a.spaces.active.region_3d.view_camera_zoom=0
  a.spaces.active.overlay.show_overlays=False
  a.spaces.active.shading.type='SOLID'
  a.spaces.active.shading.color_type='MATERIAL'
  a.spaces.active.shading.light='STUDIO'
  a.spaces.active.shading.show_shadows=True
  a.spaces.active.shading.show_cavity=True
s.render.resolution_x=1100;s.render.resolution_y=1300;s.render.resolution_percentage=100
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
print('Initial facade created',len(s.objects),'objects')

import bpy
from mathutils import Vector
s=bpy.context.scene;c=s.camera
bpy._flatiron_final_camera=(c.location.copy(),c.rotation_euler.copy(),c.data.ortho_scale)
c.location=(45,85,83);c.rotation_euler=(Vector((0,13,76))-c.location).to_track_quat('-Z','Y').to_euler();c.data.ortho_scale=29
print('Detail inspection camera ready')

import bpy
ns=bpy._flatiron_ns
src=bpy._flatiron_src
fn=src[src.index('def medallion'):src.index('for idx,(q,t,n,bw)')].replace('.28)', '.44)').replace('.30)', '.46)')
exec(fn,ns)
exec("""
verts=defaultdict(list);faces=defaultdict(list)
for q,t,n,bw in bays:
 for lo,hi in [(13,17),(71.2,74.4),(74.4,81.4)]:
  for zz in (lo+.65,(lo+hi)/2,hi-.65):medallion(q,t,n,bw/2,zz,min(.32,bw*.115))
for ma in verts:
 mesh=bpy.data.meshes.new('Raised medallions');mesh.from_pydata(verts[ma],[],faces[ma]);mesh.update();ob=bpy.data.objects.new(mesh.name,mesh);bpy.context.collection.objects.link(ob);ob.data.materials.append(mats[ma])
""",ns)
s=bpy.context.scene
s.render.engine='BLENDER_WORKBENCH'
sh=s.display.shading;sh.light='STUDIO';sh.color_type='MATERIAL';sh.show_shadows=True;sh.show_cavity=True;sh.cavity_type='BOTH';sh.curvature_ridge_factor=1.3;sh.curvature_valley_factor=1.0;sh.background_type='WORLD'

bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)
c=s.camera;c.location,c.rotation_euler,c.data.ortho_scale=bpy._flatiron_final_camera
s['reconstruction_status']='Plausible AI-guided visual approximation, not calibrated or measured. No photogrammetry.'
s['dimension_provenance']='Inherited prior-script rough memory estimates: nominal 87 m cornice height; 80 x 32 m unfilleted triangle. These are not photo-derived or verified survey values. 2.5 m corner radii, floor heights, bay spacing, ornament, colors and roof service box are artistic guesses. 22 facade intervals.'
s['validation_status']='Built through live Blender MCP in Blender 5.2.1 LTS. Initial screenshot inspected, additive facade/cornice revision made, overview and close-up inspected; medallions then raised to resolve occlusion.'
s.render.filepath=ns['OUT']+'/flatiron_live_overview.png'
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=ns['OUT']+'/flatiron_live_final.blend')

print('SAVED',bpy.data.filepath,'objects',len(s.objects))
